note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected overlays plus true level head profiles checked against neutral render; topology, junction surface and slit depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: Continuous curved head with a full-thickness oblique slit. The declared semicircular floor replaces the earlier flat termination; solid wood remains below it. Width, angle and the original edge bevel are preserved.
internal_features.finial: The upper head is lowered modestly and the button dome refitted. The first flat-button trial was rejected. Actual contact, slit opening and overall dimensions are independently checked.
internal_features.collars: The upper collar is lower and slightly narrower to retain its reference-view rim. Middle and lower collars retain the accepted shape.
internal_features.lower_body: The flare and socket are compressed 12% above the groove, with locally broader radii and a slightly wider foot. The stem is refitted to the lower socket at the original fixed camera.
internal_features.limits: The overall height reduction is modest. Reference images and camera registration are unchanged; finish remains inherited and unfinished.
